# NoteGod

> NoteGod is an all-in-one encrypted note-taking app for students, freelancers, and small teams. Notes are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and in transit with TLS 1.3, work fully offline as a PWA, and sync with Google Drive. There is a free plan (no credit card) and paid plans starting at $2.99/month.

## Key facts

- Product: web and PWA note-taking app at https://notegod.io
- Encryption: AES-256-GCM at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, per-account isolation via Row-Level Security
- Private Vault: opt-in end-to-end (zero-knowledge) encryption for individual notes; vault note content is encrypted on the user's device with a key only they hold (derived from a separate vault passphrase), so NoteGod cannot read it even if it wanted to. Backed up by a one-time recovery key.
- Offline: full offline support as a Progressive Web App, with automatic sync on reconnect
- Integrations: Google Drive sync
- Collaboration: shared projects with editor and viewer roles, comments, and an activity feed
- Pricing: Free ($0), Pro ($2.99/mo), Team ($3.99/mo); student plan at $1.49/mo with a valid .edu email
- Free trial: 7 days on paid plans, no credit card required
- Privacy: data is never sold and is never used to train machine-learning models
